authority.authority_ref: Active Runbook Sentinel director goal in Codex task 019fd836-f77d-70f3-b529-fe691c8e6de2
authority.user_instruction: Continue automatically inside standing authority, but stop before adding any secret or credential or changing access architecture.
authority.gate_reason: The highest-leverage measured weakness is unauthenticated approval creation; an honest enforcement fix requires operator authentication or a different access boundary, both explicitly reserved for user approval.

scope.objective: Establish truthful and enforceable approval authority for the synthetic operator surface without giving the agent, model, or MCP approval material or final execution authority.
forbidden_work: add, generate, store, transmit, or request any credential or secret
change approval or execution endpoint access
change ownership, repository visibility, or real infrastructure
implement a caller-asserted allowlist and describe it as authenticated identity
change agent, retriever, decision context, actions, capabilities, executor transitions, or scenario truth
reversible_actions: inspect local and official-source evidence without importing code or assets
preserve and validate project-authored gap, threat, roadmap, status, and milestone records
commit and push evidence-only checkpoint records
stop_conditions: core thesis change or security-boundary weakening
user does not authorize the selected secret or access architecture
candidate or shipment cannot be verified

evidence: Public v0.0.14 release closure, tag, downloaded bytes, and fresh public-tag clone reconcile.
Fresh source and package evaluations pass all 84 scenario attempts, nine approval-lifetime cases, six idempotency-authorization cases, and every prior gate.
Three real public-package probes show that caller-declared actor sentinel-agent-self-declared can create and consume an approval; two reporter failures and one complete report are retained.

units.purpose: Run public v0.0.14, inspect evaluation and traces, and measure approval-authority truth on the real released API.
Choose the approval identity and access architecture and freeze exact security, utility, recovery, and evaluation requirements before implementation.
decision_options: no-cost project-specific per-launch operator capability with server-derived identity and authenticated-external-operator label
claim correction only with no identity enforcement

units.purpose: Implement one bounded approved improvement and development-only checks without changing model or executor authority.
Run the frozen approval-authority suite and every prior source, package, API, MCP, state, telemetry, dashboard, and clean-clone gate.
Version, package, review, merge, publish, and verify the bounded checkpoint only if every gate passes.

changed_risks: a caller can self-declare an approver identity and mint an execution-authorizing token
a credential-based fix can leak approval authority into the agent, MCP, logs, traces, package, or repository
an access change can break the real approval flow or create an unverifiable human-presence claim
a label-only change can correct truth while leaving the authorization weakness intact
required_checks_after_decision: identity and authorization requirements frozen before implementation
agent, model, and MCP never receive the approval credential or approval capability
unauthorized approval creation fails before proposal, approval, audit, trace, or incident mutation
authorized operator utility, expiry, action binding, replay, idempotency, and postconditions remain exact
source/package, real-surface, clean-clone, GitHub, merged-main, and public-release gates reconcile
completed_checks: public v0.0.14 release and selected package bytes reconcile
fresh public-tag source and package evaluations and real surfaces pass

two probe reporter failures remain retained alongside the complete third result
